name: Erinyes
source:
The game takes place in Wakoku, basically modern Japan, 50 years after a war with the Leak koku, a neighbor dictatorship state. 50 years ago Wakoku was the invader and left a big scar in Leak koku, so big that even 50 years later both countries still don’t have any diplomatic ties and feel distrust toward each other.

The game begins in Wakoku with a wave of kidnapping that happened through the country, the protagonist Hayato wake up in a prison cell alone, the last thing he remembers being him out fishing and the mysterious men who attacked him. And he soon finds out that the place he was brought isn’t a simple prison but an entire island full of Leak koku soldiers.

[Edited from [url=https://hadlerblog.wordpress.com/2016/01/29/erinyes-a-review/]Hadler's review[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在和国，也就是现代日本。五十年前，和国曾与邻近的独裁国家雷克国交战。和国是侵略者，给雷克国留下了巨大创伤，因此即使五十年后，两国仍没有外交关系，彼此充满不信任。

游戏在和国开始：全国各地接连发生绑架案。主人公隼人醒来时独自被关在牢房里，他最后记得的是自己外出钓鱼，以及袭击他的神秘男子。很快他发现，自己被带来的地方并不是普通监狱，而是一座住满雷克国士兵的岛屿。

[改编自[url=https://hadlerblog.wordpress.com/2016/01/29/erinyes-a-review/]Hadler的评测[/url]]
